scope: Standalone OggOpusReader logical-stream identity. Canonical reader already refuses missing/repeated same-serial BOS;foreign BOS may represent another logical stream at the generic parser layer,so no canonical defect is claimed.

reference.finding: A logical stream starts with BOS carrying codec initialization;serial identifies the logical stream. Grouping and chaining need separate decoding ownership. The existing standalone reader explicitly excludes multiple logical streams.

counting: Plan one immutable logical-stream identity/BOS-boundary fix. Missing/repeated flags,header/audio placement,foreign serials,fixtures and test APIs do not add separate IDs.

Require the initial BOS and lock serial ownership after it;reject another BOS encountered before EOS,before publishing its payload or mutating identity.

Distinguish supported single-stream acceptance from explicit refusal of a second BOS inside the active stream. Existing stop-at-first-EOS behavior is preserved,including sources with a later chained stream. No claim to add streaming multiplexing or decode later chains.
